Above Title: Bronze - Origination System - Common Table Name

Column

(Tip) - Column name once in warehouse. This should generally be exactly the same as source however may be minor changes, e.g. we may have underscore where source has space

Data Type

(Tip) - Character, Numeric, Date, DateTime. Can leave blank if AI to determine most suitable type

Key

(Tip) - PK = Primary Key - Must Have. If concatenation of multiple columns put in all. FK = Foreign Key - Nice to Have. If known put the table/s it matches to.

Business Description

(Tip) - Definition of the field from a a business lens. Think of questions others may ask about the field and try to answer it. Try not to use the field name as the description (e.g. ASSET_TYPE = 'What the loan security item is, e.g. boat, house, car).

Business Data Concept

Confidentiality Classification

Is Sensitive? (Y/N)

Data Velocity

Notes / Insights / DQ issues / Operational Learnings

(Tip) - Catchall for any additional important information about the field. Add prefix (N, I, DQ, OL) for whichever it is. If added after initial creation add suffix with your initials. e.g DQ - ‘L' in Gender, only small number of cases, when doing analysis treat ‘L’ as 'U’. JG

Version

(Tip) - That last version in which this field was updated. Should be 1 for anything added before first publish

INST_NO

CHAR    (MAX 3)

PK

The reference number the software provider (TCS) gives the customer (bank, GSB). GSB is 003, so should always be 003. In other banks that own multiple banks (such as ANZ owning Suncorp), they will have different numbers for each bank they own. Should always be 3 digits.

N

1

CUSTOMER_NO

CHAR    (MAX 16)

PK

Contains the customer's GSB generated member number.

This is the same code the customer will identify with (e.g. in online banking)

1

LINK_TYPE

CHAR    (MAX 1)

PK

Defines if customer is owner/co-owner or Guaranor on the account.
A- Customer is owner/co-owner of the account
G- Customer is the guarantor to the account.

1

Contains the status of the relationship (e.g whether the relationship is open or closed)

?

  1. Validations - In case the value selected from the system drop down is ‘DEP’, the value selected from the Co-Borrower Act Option drop down should be

  1. In case the value selected from the system drop down is ‘LON’, the value selected from  the Co-Borrower Act Option drop down should be either of

1: Opt In
2: Opt Out
3: Partially Opt Out

  1. In case the value selected from the system drop down is ‘LON’ and the value selected from  the Co-Borrower Act Option drop down is ‘1: Opt In’ or ‘2: Opt Out’, no opt out document code should have been entered in the partially opt out tab.

  2. In case the value selected from the system drop down is ‘LON’ and the value selected from  the Co-Borrower Act Option drop down is ‘3: Partially Opt Out’, at least  one  opt out document code  should have been entered in the partially opt out tab.
